about_the_game:
CHAOS BECKONS

You are thrown into a world drowned in darkness and malice, you must find your way through the mysterious prison and seek the favor of various entities to get stronger. You are a one-man army, the last hope, sent by ancient aliens to fight the darkness of Uhnin and free the planet of the sorcerers oppression. A shadow similiar to yourself follows you and dark agents hunt you as you rediscover your purpose during your journey.

A NEW SOUL

You are reborn on a strange planet. Lost in place and form, you struggle to make sense of your powers. The corrupted creatures of the drowned world are hunting you. You are their target. The guardian of Uhnin arrived at last, and it's their purpose to stop your ascension.

ENDLESS STRUGGLE

The foundations of the world themselves have been re-shaped to work against the guardian. The eyes of the dark one are everywhere, the earth moves against you. The light-hungry creatures need to consume you or perish. Caught in the middle of the war of the elements, you must choose your allies wisely and seek their favor to survive.

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 (DirectX 11 support)

Recommended:

short_description: A dark-fantasy horror RPG set in space. Escape the Prison-World and confront the sorcerers-guild on a post-apocalyptic world drowned in miasma. Fight the undead, mutated creatures and raging elements. Discover shrines to power-up and build your character, and be weary of the dark agents hunting you.
